Help Vassar find a cure for the ill [[Ralena Stormbringer|Ralena]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = mesmer
}}

===Objectives===
* Find and retrieve a [[Mossy Rock|mossy rock]] from the cave near the ruins of [[Ashford]] (location shown in map).
* Return to [[Vassar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 300 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Chaos Storm}}
*{{skill icon|Mantra of Flame}}

==Walkthrough==
The cave is to the southeast of the Sanitarium. Follow the quest marker. There will be one or two Grawl boss groups in front of the cave entrance, as well as the elemental [[Grit Slingstone]] inside the cave; you do not have to kill any of them to complete the quest. Click on the mossy rock on the ground and you will obtain a Mossy Rock quest item. Take this back to Vassar.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"Trying times… yes, they certainly are.  I used to think myself above the petty concerns of lesser men, until that terrible day, living daily among all this death and destruction…  I would have given up if not for Ralena.  She has been my shining light amidst all of this… darkness.  Now she lies at death's door, afflicted by some disease brought about by the Searing.  There is still hope, however, as Master Ranger Nente informs me that a cure can be fashioned by using moss that grows on the rocks in a cave near what remains of Ashford.

:''Will you find one of these '''mossy rocks''' and help me cure Ralena?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will help you.
| decline = Your story does not move me.
| ask = Time is running short!  Seek out the cave near the ruins of Ashford and find that '''mossy rock'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Vassar
:''"A mossy rock!  You found it!  Thank Lyssa for your aid."''

==Notes==
* Combines well with [[Mesmerizing the Enemy]] as the target boss will be along the way.
